stages.name: Observe
stages.summary: The model asks focused questions through read-only repository tools.
stages.detail: OODA research can list, search, and read a bounded amount of evidence. Its results become planner context, but they carry no write authority.

stages.name: Plan
stages.summary: One model call proposes an envelope, not a stream of mutations.
stages.detail: The envelope contains complete artifact bodies, a Forth control program, and an inert rationale. At this point nothing in the workspace has changed.

stages.name: Critic
stages.summary: A deterministic abstract interpreter checks the whole proposed program.
stages.detail: It evaluates stack shape, effects, path globs, artifacts, control structure, and typed dictionary calls. Rejection returns structured errors; it never edits files or asks a model.

stages.name: Execute
stages.summary: Only an accepted program receives host capabilities.
stages.detail: The Forth VM orders artifact installation and host calls. Workspace confinement is checked again at the capability boundary. The model is not running while these words execute.

stages.name: Judge
stages.summary: Executable claims—not model confidence—decide whether the task is done.
stages.detail: Builds, tests, commands, and probes run with bounded time. Judge provenance says whether the contract was approved/hidden or merely model-authored.

stages.name: Record
stages.summary: The run leaves a hash-sequenced account rather than asking you to trust a transcript.
stages.detail: Plans, critic verdicts, mutations, gate results, cache evidence, and receipts are append-only events. Content-addressed tree hashes make before/after state auditable.

forthSteps.effect: Resolve an artifact already present in the accepted envelope.
Host checks the path and writes the bytes. This is real I/O.
Persist hashes, effects, and changed files.

runtimeRows.name: BEAM / OTP host
runtimeRows.role: Owns the loop, supervision, timeouts, and process isolation.

runtimeRows.name: Forth VM
runtimeRows.role: Actually dispatches host capabilities; not a prompt decoration.

runtimeRows.name: Typed Shen critic
runtimeRows.role: Compiled to BEAM bytecode when available; rejects before I/O.

runtimeRows.name: Gates + approved claims
runtimeRows.role: Measures completion independently of model stopping.

runtimeRows.name: Ledger + receipts
runtimeRows.role: Records decisions, mutations, and state hashes.

runtimeRows.name: OODA research
runtimeRows.role: Bounded read-only context gathering; can be disabled.

runtimeRows.name: Warm dictionary
runtimeRows.role: Loads typed words; measured use is distinct from planner mention.

runtimeRows.name: Durable Wasm components
runtimeRows.role: Runs product logic in constrained Rust components behind a write-ahead effect journal and an out-of-process provider; BEAM re-derives replay, whole-machine checkpoint recovery, forks, exactly-once effects, and crash recovery from the evidence files.

runtimeRows.name: Linda + Jido obligations
runtimeRows.role: Real leased work coordination, not the direct ld.run hot path.

runtimeRows.name: OpenResty + browser bodies
runtimeRows.role: Portability proofs sharing critic/ABI—not three layers per run.
